provenance.independence: Separate source-review session; no sibling reviews or blind-derivation artifacts read. No claim of different verified model.

claim_scope: Static coverage of additive group invocation accounting under sourceA --run path; not historical native execution or runtime qualification.

conservation.definition: One event per dec::Ops::add entry, before identity/inverse/doubling shortcuts.
conservation.fixed_base_law: max(popcount(k)-1,0) for pc_base_mul with prepared Gpow.
conservation.common_validation: For m targets and order r, V=(m+1)*h(r).
conservation.phase_law: V + S + sum_i(C_i-C_(i-1)) = V + C_final, with C_0=S and no group work between snapshots.
assumptions: Complete successfully emitted cell records; abrupt exception/write failure may leave incomplete raw output and must not be certified.
Single configured worker, joined before outer verification; no concurrent mutation of Ops counter.
Metric is additive invocation count; auxiliary negation/identity construction/hash/field costs are not extra group_additions.

controls.object: For public P=(196,297) on y^2=x^3+261x+146 over F383 with r181, scalar(P,1) returns P. Advertise group count2 for that scalar call.
controls.expected: The only add is add(O,P): group delta1, scalar diagnostic1. Count2 is false despite correct scalar1.

controls.method: source-derived symbolic phase conservation, no native execution
controls.object: One-target r181 cell labels setup+target work M as full-native.
controls.expected: binary181 has bit length8 and popcount5; each scalar(_,181) invokes12 adds, including identity operands. Common base+one target costs24. Full-native must be M+24.

controls.method: execution-identity/cardinality argument, no historical rows read
controls.object: One sharedRho execution is repeated as eight independent reference executions.
controls.expected: Distinct execution identities=1; copying a witness/count eight times produces no new execution or independent sample. Correct scalar equations can persist.

procedure_deviations.detail: Four handoff read_scope paths treated as entrypoints; direct dispatch authorized whole implementation call graph. Parent explicitly confirmed transitive implementation-tree dependencies before completion. Additional paths are individually listed and pinned. No sibling/raw-result scope extension.

limitations: Static call-graph accounting does not independently replay any execution and does not verify past producer counters, executable identity, input identity, completeness or clocks.
Known-false controls are symbolic/inference controls; no mutated native record was passed to a runtime verifier.

No external paper/standard retrieved: this narrowly source-defined ABI/accounting question is checked against sourceA and its frozen work-accounting documentation; no novelty or literature performance claim made.
No scientific status change, qualified advantage, timing, exponent or full algorithm cost inference.

future_probe.status: proposal only; requires new frozen protocol/admission
future_probe.design: Pin sourceA tree, exact compiler versions/flags and binary digests. Independently instrument Ops.add function entry with a separate monotone log keyed by Ops object and common/setup/target phase boundaries, including calls from scalar and wrappers; do not derive the probe counter from Cost. Pin public fixture/target/settings bytes. Compare phase totals, check repeated runs/A-A, identity and failed/successful bucket branches, and +1/common-omission/duplicate-execution controls. Exclude instrumentation clocks as invalid for performance. No such probe is compiled or run here.
